name: Language Switcher
author: jesusarchive
description: Input source menu and switcher for the Omarchy bar. Ctrl+Space goes back to the last source, Ctrl+Alt+Space steps to the next one.

barWidget.description: Shows the active keyboard layout as an input source icon. Click for the Input menu, or bind Ctrl+Space for the last source and Ctrl+Alt+Space for the next one.

schema.label: Show input source name
schema.description: Show the layout name next to the icon in the bar.

schema.label: Keep the switcher up while the modifier is held
schema.description: The switcher takes the keyboard and closes when you let go of Ctrl. Turn it off to close on the timeout instead.

schema.label: Hold before the switcher appears (ms)
schema.description: A Ctrl+Space quicker than this switches without showing anything. 0 shows it straight away.
